speaker: SYSTEM
text: Vesper Research Facility — Coma Ward. Day 2,557.

speaker: MNEME
text: Arin. Can you hear me? Your experiment is reactivating. If it completes, it takes the facility with it.

speaker: ARIN
text: ...who... where am I? I can't remember anything.

speaker: MNEME
text: Seven years, gone. The shutdown procedure is still in your head — buried under everything you lost. We go in and we find it.

speaker: MNEME
text: Move with WASD. Hold Shift to crouch in cover. Press E to examine memories. Avoid the things that guard them.

speaker: MNEME
text: Diving now. Hold on to yourself in there.
